fusions.name: Gnaw Through
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Deals 8 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skittering Spread
fusions.desc: Looses 4 links at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Hush Line
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later and you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Last Hole
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 90 seconds.
